The structure of Dy(Al3O4)2 crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 54-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six O atoms, while Al adopts octahedral coordination with six O neighbors; O centers have two Al neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Al and Dy octahedra and among Al octahedra, with a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph.
